Subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification - follow up

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying questions so we can get a scoped reserved capacity quote over to procurement: 

What we captured on the call:
- Target model family: 70B LLM (decoder-only), mixed workload: 70% chat/generation, 30% embeddings/reranking.
- Expected sustained volume: ~400M tokens/month; peak expected bursts up to ~2.5M tokens/day.
- Desired unit economics target: ~USD $1,200 per 1M tokens (target), budget band $40k	60k/month.
- Preferred GPU class: A100-style perf (you mentioned wanting M60-equivalent throughput; we recommended A100 or H100 equivalent depending on quantization).
- Throughput targets: ~250 tokens/sec sustained across your application; concurrency target ~60 concurrent requests at 512-token average.
- Deployment mode: Dedicated reserved capacity (SLA-backed) — you wanted a month-to-month pilot followed by a 12-month commit if numbers align.

Clarifying asks so Marcus (SE) and I can size nodes correctly: 
1) Average prompt + response length you expect per request (you gave 512 avg, confirm if that's tokens total or response tokens only).
2) Peak qps and acceptable 95th percentile latency SLO (we currently size for 95th <200ms for single-turn generation at 512 tokens on A100 clusters; H100 gives ~30% better throughput).
3) Any hard constraints around on-prem/VPC (you indicated cloud-hosted preferred).

Next steps: once you confirm the clarifications above, we will: 
- Marcus will run a throughput estimate and provide a recommended reserved capacity (GPU type + number of nodes) and expected unit cost per 1M tokens.
- I will produce a formal pilot quote (including a 30-day pilot pricing and 12-month committed pricing bands) and share a short mutual action plan for procurement.

Attaching a short capacity worksheet and will follow up with the draft quote.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — confirms everything. Quick answers inline: 

1) Avg prompt + response length: 512 tokens total (we estimate ~200 prompt / ~312 response on average).
2) Peak QPS: up to 12 QPS during busy windows (we saw brief spikes to 18 QPS in last test), concurrency target 60 as you noted. 95th percentile latency target: <300ms is acceptable for us (we can tolerate slightly higher on complex prompts).
3) Cloud-hosted is preferred (AWS us-west-2). No on-prem constraint for pilot.

One additional ask: can you include an example unit economics calc in the quote showing USD / 1M tokens for both A100-class and H100-class configurations, and the delta if we enable 4-bit quantization for generation paths? Procurement will want clear $/1M tokens and an estimate of monthly run-rate for the pilot.

I'll loop in procurement once we have the pilot quote.

Best,

Alex / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick responses, Alex. Based on 512 tokens avg / 12 QPS peak / concurrency 60, preliminary sizing: 
- Pilot recommended: 4x A100-40GB equiv nodes (NVIDIA A100-class) with optimized batching and KV prefix caching. Estimated sustained throughput: ~300–350 tokens/sec aggregate; burst throughput ~700–900 tokens/sec with batching.
- H100 configuration (if you choose H100-class): 3x H100-80GB equiv nodes — ~30–40% higher tokens/sec and lower $/1M tokens in the long-run but higher committed node cost for pilot.
- Quantization: enabling 4-bit quant (where model/quality permits) reduces GPU memory and increases throughput ~1.4×; effective $/1M tokens improves by ~25–35% depending on your workload mix.

Estimated unit economics (very rough pilot-level numbers):
- A100 pilot: ~$1,450 per 1M tokens (pilot sizing + operational overhead)
- H100 pilot: ~$1,100 per 1M tokens (higher perf offsets node cost)
- A100 + 4-bit quant: ~$1,100 per 1M tokens

For your budget band ($40k–$60k/mo) — a 4x A100 pilot yields an expected monthly token capacity of ~320–400M tokens before throttling. If you want headroom for spikes and to hit 400M sustained, we'd recommend the H100 pilot or the A100 setup with an add-on burst pool.

I'll attach the capacity estimate sheet and a pilot quote with both month-to-month pilot pricing and 12-month committed pricing bands. Marissa, I'll leave the formal quote and procurement steps to you.

—Marcus
